verdict.rationale: Zep's Graphiti-based temporal knowledge graph explicitly tracks how facts change over time and maintains provenance, and Zep's own team describes moving away from naive fact-extraction to a temporal graph specifically to handle contradiction/reconciliation issues, with edge/node deletion APIs supporting explicit correction. missing for 10: no explicit documented API or hands-on example showing automatic detection/supersession of a contradicting fact (e.g., 'address changed from X to Y' auto-invalidating the old edge) or independent benchmark validating merge/supersede accuracy.
